name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Stormwind, a summons carries a young priest from the Park to the Cathedral of Light. Nara Meideros sends you to High Priestess Laurena for further instruction.

sections.title: A Word in the Park
sections.body: In Stormwind’s Park, Nara Meideros keeps faith with Elune. The city’s spiritual guides maintain ties across their traditions. So when the Cathedral seeks a promising student, Nara sends you across the canals with quiet encouragement. The message brings good tidings, not alarm.

sections.title: The Call of the Cathedral
sections.body: At the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, you report to High Priestess Laurena. One of Stormwind’s senior clerical leaders, she guides young acolytes beyond their first prayers. Laurena teaches the sacred invocation called Desperate Prayer, a personal plea for divine aid. Near death, a servant of the Light can use it to mend grievous wounds in an instant.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Priestess Nara Meideros, a night elf cleric in Stormwind’s Park, sends word that the Cathedral leadership seeks you.

faq.q: Who do I need to report to in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Report to High Priestess Laurena inside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind’s Cathedral Square.

faq.q: What is the significance of Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer calls on divine grace to restore its caster in an instant during extreme peril. Human and dwarven clerics of the Holy Light learn it.

faq.q: Why is a night elf directing priests to the human cathedral?
faq.answer: Night elf priestesses worship Elune, while humans and dwarves follow the Holy Light. Stormwind’s spiritual orders keep close contact and mutual respect, sharing word when Alliance clerics need training.

faq.q: At what point in training does this summons occur?
aliases: when do i get desperate prayer
faq.answer: The summons comes around the tenth circle of experience, when a young priest has shown enough field skill for more demanding divine rites.

faq.q: Where is the Cathedral of Light located?
faq.answer: The Cathedral of Light dominates Cathedral Square in northern Stormwind City, between the Dwarven District and the Park.

angles.text: As a priest, this summons marks your entry into higher spiritual disciplines and opens the way to learn Desperate Prayer, an invocation that can save lives.
As a human, you find the chief sanctuary of human worship in the southern Eastern Kingdoms at the Cathedral of Light. Laurena’s guidance marks an important spiritual step.
As an Alliance member, you can see the quiet solidarity between Darnassus and Stormwind’s holy orders in the cooperation between Nara Meideros and the Cathedral clergy.
